## Summary

Nigel Smith is a DevOps and cloud infrastructure engineer who specializes in AWS, Infrastructure as Code, and automation. He brings a security-first perspective to infrastructure work and has hands-on experience migrating production systems, reducing cloud costs, and managing IT environments for small businesses.

## What I Work On

- Cloud infrastructure — AWS (IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, Cognito), GCP, CloudFormation & IaC
- Automation — Python scripts and PowerShell tools
- Systems & networking — Linux servers, Windows Server, Proxmox, Cisco, Cloudflare
- Managed IT — M365 tenant admin, Exchange triage, endpoint management, on-prem network infrastructure
